_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, so a later edit to scene.narration can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

map-quality.text: Three tiers of map quality, and the app names what the next one needs: keyframes, streamed while you scan.

open.text: Companion Scan turns a walk through a room into a 3D map.

choose-your-path.text: Scan a room with the camera, or upload a walkthrough video you already have.

ftue-permissions.text: The camera sees the room, motion tracks you, and a slow sweep keeps tracking locked.

ftue-capture-modes.text: Tap a frame, auto-capture as you walk, or stream keyframes.

ftue-quality.text: You know when a room is finished scanning, before you walk out of it.

ftue-finish.text: When you're done, export the scan and open it in the desktop editor.

live-scan.text: Walk the room and the map fills in, with coverage scored live as you go.

objects-named.text: Objects come back named and placed, identified on hardware you own.

review-and-export.text: Review everything the scan found, then export it as a file you own.

world-editor.text: Every room you scan lands in one 3D world, stored on your own server.

semantic-world.text: The map is not just geometry. Every object keeps the label it was given.

what-you-get.text: It runs in the browser on your phone and sends scans to your own server.

close.text: Companion Scan, from Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.
